audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Zaahen every stage 1-6 and hands Skill to two-plus items — the exact inverse of the packet chart and of the mirror audit, which both read Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen.
audit.why: Level 1 is even before Zaahen's trade pattern exists, and level 6 is a genuine skill stage because Realm Warp is a 3000-range roam portal that decides tempo rather than the duel. Two-plus items is Zaahen's — Ryze cannot survive a side-lane duel.
audit.corrected: Flip rows 0 and 4 to Skill and row 6 to Zaahen, in both layers, with ratings 5/10, 5/10 and 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phases carried no cooldown numbers — the packet defect is literally 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1, Spell Flux is 3.5s, Overload is a flat 5s reset by every other cast, Realm Warp is 180s at rank 1. Zaahen's Q and E are both 10s at rank 1, his R 110s.
audit.corrected: Attach the real numbers to the Do's, the level 6 phase and the spike text so 'wait for X before you Y' becomes concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zaahen's E is called 'Golden Onslaught' — the missing-interaction data names it Aureate Rush (E), with The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Dreaded Return (W). The page also states Rune Prison as a flat root; it only roots if the target already carries Spell Flux, otherwise it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Dodging the Spell Flux orb downgrades his only lockdown to a slow — that is the decisive interaction of the lane and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Use the real names, and state that Spell Flux (E, 3.5s) is the setup: dodge the orb and Rune Prison cannot root you, so your Aureate Rush gap-close goes through.

edits.before: Level 6 is hard-favoured — his R is a roam tool while your R kills.
edits.after: Level 6 is a skill check — Realm Warp roams, so punish it or lose tempo.

edits.before: Your R is the kill window — bank it until his answer is committed. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R is the kill window at 110s rank 1 — but Realm Warp is a 3000-range portal, so level 6 is decided by whether you punish his roam.

edits.before: Ryze is a squishy immobile mage with no early lane control — once your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught are up you walk him down every trade, and his only peel is Rune Prison (W) root, which you eat and still kill through if you time your E gap-close.
edits.after: Ryze is a squishy immobile mage with no early lane control — once The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10s) and Aureate Rush (E, 10s) are up you walk him down every trade, and his only peel is Rune Prison (W), which needs Spell Flux on you first to root at all.

edits.before: You dominate 3 through 6: your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught let you walk him down through his Rune Prison (W) root, and at 6 his non-combat R Realm Warp gives him no answer to your Final Retribution all-in.
edits.after: You dominate 3 through 5: The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Aureate Rush (E) walk him down, and Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux (E) landed first — dodge the orb and his W is a slow you tank straight through to the kill.

edits.before: Kite with Overload (Q) resets and W root
edits.after: Land Spell Flux first so Rune Prison roots

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and only roots through Spell Flux — dodge the orb and it is a slow.

notes: Level-chart rows 0, 4 and 6 are proposed as matched full/content pairs plus their ratings, as one atomic group. Zaahen's W still has no verified name in the kit file (the missing-interaction data calls it Dreaded Return; the kit carries no names at all), so it is left described by effect here. 'Final Retribution' for his R comes from existing page text only — recorded in unverified.
